messages.text:
Hi Monica, just a heads up: the Cloudflare renewal for TNM is due, and I’m using this as an opportunity to work with CF on optimizing pricing as our footprint grows, especially with Sayso.

The goal is to unlock more runway as we scale and, if possible, secure some startup credits.

We’ll also be consolidating Recount, TNM, and Sayso under a single billing umbrella so we move from three separate renewals to one. That should simplify renewals and help unlock bundling and volume-based pricing discounts.

Happy to sync if you have any questions. I had an initial intro call today, and Cloudflare is going to come back with numbers. Let me know if you’d like to join the next discussion.
